address: Unit 3-48, 48F, Naza Tower, Platinum Park, 10 Persiaran KLCC, Kuala Lumpur, 50088, Malaysia
bio: Based on Kappo cuisine, chef Yoshida's philosophy aims to establish a bond between the diner and the chef. Veteran chef Hattori dons the role of culinary host by tailoring this omakase beef experience at the counter for 12 guests in an intimate setting. This satisfying feast for beef lovers uses different parts of premium Wagyu from Japan in each dish. There are seafood sets for non-beef eaters. The lunch set and à la carte menus are great value....
